title: Medicare Advantage plans with dental and vision
summary: Describes the dental and vision benefits available with UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plans and how they differ from Original Medicare, which does not cover routine dental or vision.

atoms.title: Original Medicare excludes routine dental and vision
atoms.question: Does Original Medicare cover routine dental and vision?
atoms.text: Original Medicare (Part A and Part B) covers medically necessary care for the diagnosis or treatment of an illness or condition, but it does not cover routine dental and vision services. Most Medicare Advantage plans do cover them, including many preventive and comprehensive dental services from routine cleanings to dentures, and vision services such as routine eye exams that can help protect your eyesight and may save you money on glasses frames or contact lenses.

atoms.title: Dental benefits in UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage
atoms.question: What dental benefits can a UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plan include?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare dental benefits may provide coverage for dental care otherwise not included with Original Medicare. Benefits may include no annual deductible, access to a large national dental network, and preventive services such as oral exams, routine cleanings, x-rays and fluoride treatments. Comprehensive services like fillings, crowns, root canals, extractions, bridges and dentures may also be included.

atoms.title: Dental benefits vary by plan
atoms.question: Are dental benefits the same on every Medicare Advantage plan?
atoms.text: Dental benefits vary by plan, so each plan's details should be explored carefully to see what is and isn't included, as well as the savings you may receive. Benefit availability and coverage may also vary by service area.

atoms.title: Vision benefits in UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage
atoms.question: What vision benefits can a UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plan include?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare vision benefits provide services not included in Original Medicare that help protect your eyesight and may save you money on eyewear. Benefits may include a routine eye exam at no cost and access to a large national network of vision providers and retail locations.

atoms.title: Free lenses and online eyewear options
atoms.question: Do UnitedHealthcare Medicare Advantage plans cover eyeglass lenses?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare vision benefits may include free standard prescription lenses, including single vision, bifocal, trifocal and Tier I (standard) progressive lenses, all with scratch-resistant coating. Eyewear is also available from many online providers, including Warby Parker and GlassesUSA. Benefit availability and coverage may vary by service area.

atoms.title: Dental and vision care matter for overall health
atoms.question: Why do dental and vision benefits matter in a Medicare plan?
atoms.text: Dental and vision care are important to your overall health. Routine preventive and comprehensive services can help protect your teeth and eyes. Because Original Medicare does not cover routine dental and vision services, many people look to Medicare Advantage plans for these benefits.

atoms.title: The UnitedHealthcare Right Plan Promise
atoms.question: What is the UnitedHealthcare Right Plan Promise?
atoms.text: The UnitedHealthcare Right Plan Promise is the company's commitment to helping you find the right plan for you. UnitedHealthcare states that choosing a Medicare plan doesn't have to feel overwhelming, and that its easy-to-use online experience and Medicare Plan Experts make it simple to find the right UnitedHealthcare plan.
